relationships.subject: verbascoside
relationships.evidence_quote: UVB radiation exposure led to a significant reduction in the mRNA expression levels of NRF2, HO-1 and NQO1. Conversely, pre-treatment with poliumoside and verbascoside upregulated the expression levels of these genes.

key_findings: BOE protects UVB-irradiated HaCaT cells from oxidative damage, restoring NRF2, HO-1 and NQO1 expression
Poliumoside and verbascoside are active constituents that also upregulate NRF2/HO-1/NQO1
